tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Search the catalog of about 70 free Arabic Excel templates (students, clinics, shops, farms, rent, installments, payroll, recipe costing, gym...). Returns id, Arabic title, description, sector, page URL and download URL for each match. Use it first whenever the user needs a tracking sheet or a multi

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Returns the structure of one template: its sheets, the record tables (header row, first and last row, capacity) with each column marked as input or formula, example values, dropdown values, the settings cells (label, cell address, sample value) and the result cells. tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Fills a template with the records and settings you send, recalculates it with the template's own formulas, and returns the results: the summary cells listed in get_schema plus the calculated columns of every row you sent. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_templates, calculate, run_calculator · Private data: get_schema, calculate, get_download · Public sink: get_schema, calculate · Destructive: run_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_templates, calculate, run_calculator · Private data: get_schema, calculate, get_download · Public sink: get_schema, calculate · Destructive: run_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
